name: HTML & CSS
description: Structuring web pages with semantic HTML and styling them with modern CSS, including Flexbox, Grid and responsive design.

questions.question: Which HTML element is most appropriate for the main navigation links of a site?
questions.explanation: <nav> is the semantic element for major navigation blocks and is exposed as a landmark to assistive technology.

questions.question: Which CSS selector targets all elements with class="card"?
questions.explanation: A leading dot selects by class; # selects by id and a bare name selects by element type.

questions.question: With box-sizing: border-box, an element has width: 200px, padding: 20px and border: 5px. What is its rendered outer width (excluding margin)?
questions.explanation: With border-box, the declared width includes padding and border, so the total stays 200px.

questions.question: In a flex container with the default flex-direction: row, which property horizontally centers the items?
questions.explanation: justify-content aligns items along the main axis, which is horizontal for flex-direction: row.

questions.question: Which selector has the highest specificity?
questions.explanation: #main .title has specificity (1,1,0); the others contain no ID selector, so it wins.

questions.question: What does grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)) do?
options: Creates one column that is always 200px wide
Creates as many columns of at least 200px as fit the container, stretching them to share leftover space
questions.explanation: auto-fit with minmax creates a responsive grid that wraps columns without media queries, collapsing empty tracks so items expand.

practical.title: Center a card with Flexbox
practical.instructions: Write the CSS rule for a .container element that uses Flexbox to center its child both horizontally and vertically, and makes the container fill the full viewport height.
practical.expected_output: .container { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; }

rubric.hint: Set display: flex on the container.
Give the container min-height: 100vh so there is vertical space to center in.

tasks.title: Learn HTML and CSS fundamentals
tasks.description: Work through the MDN Learn web development modules on HTML structure and CSS basics, including selectors, the box model and the cascade.
tasks.completion_criteria: Completes the MDN assessment challenges for HTML basics and CSS building blocks.

tasks.title: Build a semantic personal profile page
tasks.description: Create a single-page profile using semantic elements (header, nav, main, section, footer), an image with alt text and a styled contact form.
tasks.completion_criteria: Page passes the W3C HTML validator with no errors and uses at least 5 semantic elements.

tasks.title: Create a responsive layout with Grid and Flexbox
tasks.description: Build a responsive product listing page that uses CSS Grid for the card layout and Flexbox for card internals. Add media queries so it works from 320px phones to wide desktops.
tasks.completion_criteria: Layout has no horizontal scrolling at 320px and adapts to at least 3 breakpoints.

tasks.title: Build a multi-page responsive website
tasks.description: Design and build a 3-page website for a fictional business using custom properties for theming, a dark mode, CSS transitions and accessible forms. Deploy it to a free static host.
tasks.completion_criteria: Deployed site with 3 pages, CSS variables, dark mode and a Lighthouse accessibility score of at least 90.
